lines.text: Put every day at the end!
Many learners say: I drink every day tea.
Better: I drink tea every day.
Put every day at the end.
The second! I drink coffee every day.

data.why: Put every day at the end.

native.tip: Türkçede “Her gün çay içerim.” deriz, “her gün” başta durur; İngilizcede “every day” genelde sonda durur: “I drink tea every day.”
native.caption: “I drink every day tea” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “every day” fiille nesnenin arasına girmez, cümlenin sonunda durur. Doğrusu “I drink tea every day.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.

en.tip: Put “every day” at the end: “I drink tea every day.”
en.caption: Do you say “I drink every day tea”? 😅 In English “every day” does not go between the verb and the thing. It goes at the end. The right sentence is “I drink tea every day.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
